verdict.rationale: Whether an email client's source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Shortwave publishing its source code or naming an open-source license. The pack covers only hosted SaaS features, and users wishing for a local or Thunderbird-style client is not evidence of openness either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
